<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914464_theRebbe_108" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914464_theRebbe_108__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The vessel for these two matters is the unity of Israel in two modes, which also applies to individual divine service and prepares for the true redemption through Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the vessel for these two matters is the unity of Israel in two modes.</t>
    <t s="1">That each one receives from his fellow,</t>
    <t s="2">and that all of Israel are one structure.</t>
    <t s="3">And likewise in the individual service of each and every one,</t>
    <t s="4">that there are these two matters in it.</t>
    <t s="5">The service of the ten powers of his soul</t>
    <t s="6">(which are analogous to the ten categories from your heads, your tribes, until the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water54)</t>
    <t s="7">in a manner that all the powers receive from each other and complete each other,</t>
    <t s="8">and the service from the aspect of Yechidah, which is above division.</t>
    <t s="9">And this is also a proximate preparation for the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="10">for the matter of Moshiach is Yechidah55.</t>
    <t s="11">And this is that in every Jew there is a spark of Moshiach56,</t>
    <t s="12">that the particular Yechidah in each and every Jew is a spark of the general Yechidah of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="13">[And analogous to Moshe</t>
    <t s="14">(the first redeemer57)</t>
    <t s="15">that in each and every Jew there is the aspect of Moshe within him58],</t>
    <t s="16">he will come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="17">in the true and complete redemption speedily, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
